threat_event: Internet-exposed building automation controllers are taken over
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 9 BAS controllers reachable from the internet (P07)
treatment_plan: Remove internet exposure; remote access through a managed gateway

threat_event: Shared vendor logins to access control allow unauthorized entry to tenant buildings
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Access control consoles use shared vendor logins
treatment_plan: Named accounts with MFA on vendor consoles; quarterly review

threat_event: Tenants are tricked into paying rent to a fraudulent account
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Tenants receive remittance details by email
existing_controls: Lockbox; one 2026 attempt caught by a tenant
treatment_plan: Remittance changes only through the tenant portal; tenant notice

threat_event: Guarantor personal financial information is breached
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 210 guarantor files in the property system and email
treatment_plan: Move guarantor files out of email; retention limit

threat_event: Right-of-way drawings shared with licensees include security-sensitive details
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Screening by rail security staff, but no checklist

threat_event: Tenant portal account takeover exposes lease data
existing_controls: Portal shows only the tenant own leases

threat_event: A building OT vendor breach reaches group buildings
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor contracts lack security terms; 3 of 5 vendors provide no assurance report
existing_controls: Vendor consoles separate from the corporate network
treatment_plan: Security terms at renewal; assurance reports or questionnaires

threat_event: Unknown building OT devices are exploited
Lease abstraction tool extracts wrong terms
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Tool live before the AI Standard
treatment_plan: Accepted at Low; council review scheduled

threat_event: Building security practices differ without a division standard
treatment_plan: Division supplement with building OT standard (P06)

threat_event: Refrigeration controls fail in a temperature-controlled warehouse
existing_controls: Alarms to building engineers; manual control

threat_event: Storm damage to building network closets
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Closets at ground level in 14 coastal buildings
